summary_1line: Bhishma recounts sages gathering at sacred waters, Agastya’s lotus stalks disappearing, and numerous rishis swearing dire oaths to prove innocence.

image_candidates.scene_text: Dozens of ancient rishis and kings stand around the sacred lake Brahmasara as Agastya angrily points to the empty place where his lotus stalks had been laid.
The gathered sages on the full-moon night of Magha bathe in the shining waters of the Kausiki river before collecting lotus stalks along the bank.
One after another, solemn rishis raise their hands and swear terrible oaths before Agastya and the watching Indra.
